case.title: Yarn

steps.c: Green: magic ring, ch 1. Rnd 1: 6 sc in ring, pull tight.
Rnd 2: 2 sc in each st around. 12 sts.
Rnd 3: *sc 1, 2 sc in next*; repeat around. 18 sts.
Join blue. Rnd 4: *sc 2, 2 sc in next*; repeat. 24 sts.
Sl st to join, cut yarn 15 cm, weave in ends.
